author: musho7-dev
subject: Add pause button and pause menu
body:
- Pause button (top right of HUD) freezes the game and opens a menu:
  Resume, Restart, Garage, End run and see results
- Restart and Garage keep the coins and best distance from the run
- Auto-pauses on iPhone when the app loses focus (call, home button)
- Esc or P toggles pause on keyboard

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
